response.sql:
WITH per_site AS (
  SELECT
    s.zoneref,
    sites.entrystat,
    AVG(s.memusagegb) AS avg_ram,
    AVG(1.0 * s.procgpu / NULLIF(s.proccpu, 0)) AS avg_gpu_cpu_ratio
  FROM scanprocessing AS s
  JOIN sites ON sites.zoneregistry = s.zoneref
  WHERE s.memusagegb >= 60.8
  GROUP BY s.zoneref, sites.entrystat
)
SELECT
  entrystat,
  AVG(avg_ram) AS avg_per_site_ram,
  AVG(avg_gpu_cpu_ratio) AS avg_per_site_gpu_cpu_ratio
FROM per_site
GROUP BY entrystat;

assumptions.assumption: “Using 60.8 GB of RAM as the cutoff” means retaining runs with memusagegb >= 60.8; zero CPU usage is treated as an undefined ratio and excluded from that ratio’s average.
